The '''lungless''' were a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]]. These Gands did not possess [[Lung/Legends|lungs]] and therefore did not respire; they obtained their bodies' necessary metabolic ingredients through the ingestion of their food.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The ingested materials aided in gas exchange and waste would be passed through openings in the [[exoskeleton]].<ref name="EGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> Unlike the [[Breather Gand|breather]] race, lungless Gands could venture offworld without the need of [[Breath mask/Legends|respiratory equipment]], though some would wear such equipment anyway, usually to maintain anonymity.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Lungless Gands spoke their [[Gand (language)/Legends|native language]] and did not possess the proper vocal cords to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="SAV">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> In order to do so, they required the aid of a muscular gas bladder that allowed them to draw in and expel gases at a controlled rate through the exoskeleton. Pieces of the exoskeleton would then vibrate to approximate speech.<ref name="AA">''[[Alien Anthology]]''/''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref>

[[Ooryl Qrygg]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], was a member of this subspecies.<ref name="RS">''[[X-Wing: Rogue Squadron]]''</ref>
